AquaLife

A little life, lived your way.

👋 Welcome back

📲 Install puts AquaLife on your home screen — opened from there, it runs fullscreen like a real app, no browser bars.

✨ Start a new life

How do you want to begin?

⚡ Quick Life

Answer what you care about; anything you skip rolls 🎲 random. Then the life is built from your answers — partner, kids and job set up to match, through the game's normal systems.

🛠️ Make Your Own Life

👇 live preview, right here in the style box

🏠 One thing you never pick: where your family lives. When the life starts, the dice roll your family's home — 🏠 a house, 🏢 an apartment, 🏘️ a townhouse, 🏙️ a condo… or 📦 no home at all: the street, with a box. Sometimes parents have a house; sometimes they are just getting by. It's random — the roll is the roll.

🔒 A name is set when a life is made and stays locked for that whole life.

Age 10

👶 Teen, adult and elder starts can begin life already parents. Say yes and every starting child gets two parents on the family tree — you, and their other parent — connected forever, whatever happens to the romance. (Your own origin family above is untouched: this is YOUR generation, your kids.)

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Other parent #1 — for all the children

Who is the other parent of your children? Create them yourself, or let AquaLife generate them as a full NPC — either way they are a real, persistent person in this world.
